definitions: A river in the Mid North Coast region of New South Wales, Australia.
A local government area in the Mid North Coast region of New South Wales, Australia, named after the Nambucca River.
A town in New South Wales, Australia, located at the mouth of the Nambucca River.
examples: The Nambucca flows into the Pacific Ocean.
The Nambucca Shire is known for its beautiful beaches.
We visited Nambucca Heads last summer.
